items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: Only a piano, just sort of the same system as Miss Luma's.

ctx.x: I'd like to ask you a question about the Annex. When you were playing at the Annex, was it only a piano or was it a band there?
No, no, only a piano. Only a piano, just sort of the same system as Miss Luma's.
Were you at the Annex or at Gertrude Dix's? Which were you in?
